actual_message_definition.HyboNet: observed LorentzLinear outputs Z; actual native sparse A*Z then Lorentz normalization
actual_message_definition.HGCN: observed logmap0(HypLinear output); actual native sparse tangent support then Exp/projection/Log/ReLU/Exp/projection

raw_privileged.FP_identity: Approximate FP64 reconstruction uses rounded double N/k and sums. The two residual estimates decompose native minus that approximate reconstruction up to FP64 arithmetic; not an exact real-HT identity or native FP32 certificate. Feature producer separately records outward real-center intervals and reconstruction bounds.
raw_privileged.HyboNet_q_status: denominator is actual native observer output; pre-abs q explicitly reconstructed with the native inner operation from the observed aggregate
raw_privileged.first_input_alias: All sampled/restored first inputs must equal the full first input exactly; store once in raw/full-state.pt, with lossless raw-only alias. S contains no full-state reference.
raw_privileged.plans: sample raw tapes include actual_plans; full native adjacency in guarded/public input

O.contains: pre-plan full messages/state/head scores, frozen weights and public graph only

S.contains: one path, row-local selected incoming messages/original coefficients/HT coefficients, observed local state and native head scores; public graph and frozen weights
S.covariance: Use original_native_coefficients times selected_incoming_messages, excluding deterministic self. Never use HT_native_coefficients as x_j coefficients. k1<N unavailable; k=N or N<=1 exact zero.
S.same_path_plugins: sample center, g/r, head pair and training-node tau are correlated random plugins, not unbiased nonlinear/signed forecasts
S.row_local_rule: A feature for node i may not read another row's deterministic self message as i's omitted message. The API enforces row-local retrieval; it is an algorithmic information contract, not a cryptographic boundary.
S.finite_envelope: S omitted-population envelope unavailable for k<N. HGCN pointwise inverse-safe permits smooth structural zeros only; whole-segment safety separately required for finite envelope zero.

targets.margin: Native raw-head true-class minus best-other raw score, with rival switching. HGCN predictions use the actual native log_softmax output.
targets.heldout_lock: Root hash-locks fit inputs/scalers/coefficients and all corresponding heldout predictions before reading targets. Code/Ops print only file/work counts, never aggregate evaluation effects.

fit_interventions.HyboNet: 16 central first-full restorations per CP with actual incoming messages and unchanged sampled suffix; cheap final continuations; four all-class scaled projection/normalizer accounting channels
fit_interventions.HGCN: one aggregation: AhatZ=AhatZhat, AZhat=AZ and first-full=AZ; two actual conditions; no additional encode
fit_interventions.channels: 2<m,p_c>_L + nu(m)b_c; omit common 2nu. Accounting channel is neither a manifold intervention nor a deployable native score.

operator_constants.HyboNet: native abs/clamp 1e-8; sigmoid time+1.1 and native trainable scale; weights from CP
operator_constants.HGCN: fixed c=1; Poincare FP32 eps4e-3, min_norm1e-15; tanh helper clamps[-15,15]; native artanh clamps[-1+1e-15,1-1e-15] then float64 log/cast

predictors_owner: Root; Code supplies prospectively fixed analytic features and raw data, no fits
ReLU_envelope: Root's registered raw sum_j abs(w_j)*d_j; not log-transformed or divided by tau by Code
public_export_note: Historical source-review configuration; not an execution authorization. Original collector output is already collected; use public fit scalar summary.
